conventions: Read on audit/u35-braise2 after its three fixes, against v1.29.0 (agent, 2026-10-27). Shared with asy_config_manager.json's conventions (the C-stack class, the small fixed allocations F.2 sends to I.4(a)), and here, by caller: __init__, begin_boot(), setup(), run_setups(), start_tasks(), start_timers() and supervise_tasks() run from build_system() or main() inside asyncio.run(main()), under the generated entry's except BaseException (build/generated_src/sensortask_<device>_main.py:38, buildgen/codegen.py:867), which records the loop end after BOOT_DONE (record_loop_end()) and leaves the armed watchdog to reset; _status_loop() is a supervised task, whose end :326's except Exception in _log_dead_task() persists before the restart (I.4(c)); the four system commands and pause_permanent_storage() are called only from the generated _system_cmd_callback(), which asy_webserver_service.py's _run_system_cmd() awaits in its try catching Exception (except :908, answer "Failed"); _set_dict_cfg() and get_dict_cfg() run on REST routes, under Microdot's except Exception (ext/microdot.py:1533) and the webserver's errorhandler (asy_webserver_service.py:791); _reboot()'s two callers sit in a try catching Exception (:498, :618). The unsupervised task tops (_reset_when_due, _shutdown_sequence, the supervisor) catch Exception themselves; their handlers' logging rows are asy_print_log.py's. Three raise paths left lasting state behind and are fixed with their tests: a raising erase preflight wedged the command gate (:394-396 now restore it), a raising unpause spent the mempause deadline (:532 and :714 now spend it after the unpause), and a raising signature line let the restarted loop draw a second boot signature (:538, :544 set the flag with the value); the third's trigger is pr.one(), asy_print_log.py's row.
